slides.title: Inference Optimization Drivers

cards.body: FP8 quantization enables 4x throughput on current generation GPU clusters.
Continuous batching directly lowers cost per million tokens served.

slides.title: Three-Phase Rollout Architecture
bullets: Phase 1: Deploy vLLM orchestration clusters with PagedAttention across primary zones.
Phase 2: Integrate autonomous visual document quality inspection pipelines.
Phase 3: Establish automated CI/CD synchronization with version-controlled skills.
